name: Superhuman
tagline: A swarm of AI agents searches CCTV footage in parallel, restores damaged frames and matches suspects from text descriptions.
problem: Investigators review surveillance footage clip by clip, too slowly for urgent cases.
solution: Over twenty agents analyse feeds in parallel; video inpainting restores occluded frames; vision-language models and face re-identification match natural-language descriptions; a generative layer predicts trajectories.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a person and see matching clips across cameras.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Stacks many techniques (inpainting, re-identification, VLM retrieval) in one pipeline.
Won the privacy and security category while being a surveillance tool; the civil-liberties trade-off is not addressed in its summary.

lessons: Technical depth can win a security category, but expect hard questions on misuse.
